spec_features.feature_name: loop termination on submit_done / budget / error
spec_features.spec_quote: Repeat until `submit_done`, turn budget hit, or hard error
spec_features.evidence: agent.py: `if ws.done: ep.ended_reason='submit_done'; break` (submit_done sets ws.done in env.py Workspace.submit_done); `for ... range(max_turns) ... else: ep.ended_reason='budget'`; surrounding try/except sets ep.ended_reason='error'. submit_done is dispatched (env.py dispatch) and honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: All three termination paths are wired and change execution.
